farewell.title: Thank You
farewell.lead: After an incredible journey, Sharx is closing its doors.
farewell.gratitude: To our users, clients, partners and friends around the world: thank you for trusting us, for using CutCab and RotaIQ, and for every idea, piece of feedback and kind word you shared with us along the way.
farewell.dream: Sharx was born from a strong friendship and a common dream: to make this world a little better for everyone. You made that dream real, and we are deeply grateful.
